method.network: AST inspection of named REST transports, fetch, WebSocket, EventSource, beacon and service-worker calls, plus removal of known SDK and dynamic remote-image loaders. This is a targeted source audit, not a proof about every possible execution state.
method.resources: Every shipped file was requested with HEAD from an ordinary local static host. Entry points were loaded from the root and a project subdirectory.
method.runtime: Browser observations and gameplay scope are recorded separately in browser-validation.json.
method.inventory: Snapshot before generating package-manifest.json. That manifest records the final packaged payload hashes. Local asset XHR remains necessary and is not external networking.
